card.name: Start of abbreviated technical names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a short abbreviation or code-like name, such as Cmd in keyboard shortcuts, tmp in tmpfile, or msg and MSG. It appears in software manuals and tutorials.

modes.label: Keyboard shortcut keys
modes.description: Cmd at the start of a Cmd/Ctrl shortcut in design tutorials.
modes.example: Press<< Cmd>>/Ctrl+U and adjust the Hue

modes.label: Programming names
modes.description: The start of a function or variable name like tmpfile, msg or avg in manuals.

modes.label: Capitalized abbreviations
modes.description: Abbreviations such as MSG or the CNT in rhCNTF.
modes.example: 440,000 allogeneic retinal pigment epithelial cells expressing recombinant human ciliary neurotrophic factor (rh<<CNT>>F).
